en.title: QR Code Verification System
en.excerpt: How schools, universities, and federations verify digital certificate authenticity using tamper-proof QR codes.
en.content:
Tamper-Proof Verification System

Every certificate generated by Archeris contains an embedded, cryptographically unique UUID. This identifier is permanently registered in the central database.

Scanning the Certificate QR Code

Anyone inspecting a certificate (such as school admission boards, sports scholarships committees, or national federation selectors) can scan the printed QR code using any smartphone camera.

Official Verification Record Details

The QR code opens the official verification page at archeris.net/certificates/[uuid], displaying:

  • Verified Athlete Name and Photo.
  • Tournament Title and Organizing Body.
  • Competition Division and Official Placement / Score.
  • Date of Issuance and Verification Status (Verified Authentic).

Preventing Document Forgery

Modifying the text on a PDF certificate is rendered useless because the verification database confirms the true original score and ranking.
